name: GD RL Env
description: Exposes Geometry Dash as a gym-style RL environment over TCP.

rl-enabled.name: RL mode
rl-enabled.description: Freeze the game and step it only on commands from the trainer. Set BEFORE entering a level.

record-first.name: Record reference run
record-first.description: Play the level yourself (Space/Up/Click) at fixed 240 TPS; the run is saved to gdrl_reference.bin. Turn OFF afterwards.

use-replay.name: Rebuild snapshots from the reference file
use-replay.description: On level entry, replay gdrl_reference.bin to rebuild the snapshots, then start the server.

snapshot-spacing.name: Snapshot spacing (units)
snapshot-spacing.description: Distance in x between snapshots. Smaller = finer curriculum stages but more memory.

hide-render.name: Hide level rendering (faster)
hide-render.description: Hides the level layer while replaying/serving. Turn off to watch the agent.

frame-budget-ms.name: Max ms of stepping per rendered frame
frame-budget-ms.description: Higher = more throughput but a less responsive window.

port.name: TCP port
port.description: Localhost port. Overridden by the GDRL_PORT environment variable (set by the launcher).

dt-scale.name: Tick dt scale
dt-scale.description: Multiplier on 1/240 s per tick. Must match between recording and replay.
